ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT($Permission.Bypass_Automation), NOT(ISBLANK(Term_Months__c)), NOT(OR(Term_Months__c = 36, Term_Months__c = 48, Term_Months__c = 60, Term_Months__c = 72, Term_Months__c = 84, Term_Months__c = 96)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Term must be one of 36, 48, 60, 72, 84, or 96 months.
